items.name: AT Protocol
items.desc: Open social network protocol (the basis of Bluesky): federated identity, feeds on the subscriber's algorithms, PDS hosting. SDK, docs.

items.name: AtEar
items.desc: A Wi-Fi auditing framework: cracking wireless networks, vulnerability analysis and pentesting. JavaScript, tuned for wireless security.

items.name: MyPublicWiFi
items.desc: program for Windows that turns an ordinary computer into a Wi-Fi router (access point)

items.name: OpenWrt
items.desc: Linux firmware for routers: replaces the stock firmware with a full Linux with packages, VPN, firewall and fine network tuning.

items.name: WiFiSpace
items.desc: a map of Wi-Fi points with passwords around the world, added by users

items.name: Ad Guard Home
items.desc: Ad blocking at the provider level

items.name: Cloudflare Diagnostics
items.desc: Online network diagnostics from Cloudflare: traceroute by AS, DNS resolution, port checks, WARP status — in the browser with no installation.

items.name: DNS Server
items.desc: network-wide ad blocking + protection from ISP tracking

items.name: DPI Checkers
items.desc: checking whether an internet provider blocks sites

items.name: firewalld
items.desc: Linux firewall daemon with zones and D-Bus API, frontend for nftables; default in Fedora/RHEL; free, GPL.

items.name: Glasswire
items.desc: network monitoring

items.name: Gufw
items.desc: Graphical firewall UI for ufw on Ubuntu/desktop Linux; free, GPL.

items.name: Libreswan
items.desc: IPsec implementation for Linux, fork of Openswan/FreeS/WAN, IKEv2; free, GPL.

items.name: MyIP
items.desc: everything about your IP in one window: address, geo, DNS, WebRTC leaks, speed and access to services

items.name: nftables
items.desc: Linux kernel packet filtering framework replacing iptables: tables, chains, sets; free, GPL.

items.name: OpenSnitch
items.desc: Interactive application firewall for Linux (eBPF): per-connection allow/deny prompts; GPL-3.0.

items.name: OpenVPN
items.desc: Mature TLS VPN client/server; Access Server paid, Community Edition free; core OSS under GPL.

items.name: oproxy
items.desc: local proxy tool for developers: it intercepts HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 traffic, shows requests and responses, and lets you replace or edit them (mocks, delays, redirects)

items.name: PortCheck
items.desc: Simple Windows GUI to check IPv4 TCP ports on a host: editable target IP, adjustable timeout with F1-F4 hotkeys, single exe; C# WinForms; MIT.

items.name: ProxyBridge
items.desc: An open-source analog of Proxifier in C: redirects any TCP/UDP traffic on Windows/macOS/Linux into an HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy. Forces any applications through a proxy.

items.name: Shadowsocks for Windows
items.desc: Classic SOCKS5 proxy client for bypassing blocks: encrypted traffic, server configs, QR import. Open-source C#.

items.name: Simple Wall
items.desc: Blocking internet access for specific sites

items.name: Sniffnet
items.desc: complete monitoring of my computer's network traffic

items.name: SoftEther VPN
items.desc: Multi-protocol VPN server: SSL-VPN, L2TP, OpenVPN clones; university project; free, Apache-2.0.

items.name: SpoofDPI
items.desc: A simple and fast anti-censorship tool in Go: bypasses providers' DPI (deep packet inspection) with a single binary.

items.name: strongSwan
items.desc: IPsec-based VPN solution for Linux with IKEv1/v2, EAP, PKI; free, GPL.

items.name: tcpdump
items.desc: Classic CLI packet analyzer with libpcap filters; free, BSD.

items.name: ufw
items.desc: Uncomplicated Firewall: simple CLI front-end for iptables/ufw frontends, default in Ubuntu; free, GPL.

items.name: VyOS
items.desc: Open-source network OS: routing, firewall, VPN on x86 and cloud; free rolling release plus paid LTS; GPL.

items.name: WireGuard
items.desc: Modern fast VPN with small codebase and cryptokey routing; in-kernel since Linux 5.6; free, GPL/MIT mix.

items.name: Wireshark
items.desc: Standard network traffic analyzer: deep dissection of hundreds of protocols, live capture, filters, follow stream. Detail view of any packet.

items.name: KDE Connect
items.desc: links a PC and a phone into one whole system

items.name: LinuxPlay
items.desc: This is a remote access program: you connect from your Windows computer to a Linux one, with the screen, sound and mouse transmitted with minimal latency, as for network gaming.

items.name: TigerVNC
items.desc: Classic VNC server for Linux remote desktop

items.name: Autoruns
items.desc: utility for Windows. Shows everything that starts automatically at system startup: programs, services, browser extensions. Helps find and disable what is unnecessary or malicious

items.name: Cores
items.desc: beautiful hardware monitoring app (CPU, GPU, RAM, temperatures) with an emphasis on visual design. Convenient for those who care about aesthetics, not just numbers

items.name: Glances
items.desc: Cross-platform system monitor in Python: CPU/RAM/disks/network/processes/Docker in one TUI, web UI, API and export to StatsD/CSV; like top, for all OSes.

items.name: Libre Hardware Monitor
items.desc: full real-time hardware monitoring

items.name: Netscanner
items.desc: A network scanner and diagnostic tool in the terminal with a modern TUI: ARP scan, ping, packet analysis, OUI lookup, Wi-Fi diagnostics. Rust.

items.name: NtWarden
items.desc: program for Windows that shows what is really going on inside the system "under the hood": which processes are running, which drivers are loaded, which network connections are open, etc.

items.name: OpenHardwareMonitor
items.desc: free open-source program for Windows. Shows the temperature of the processor, graphics card, hard drives, fan speeds and voltages in real time

items.name: SigDigger
items.desc: digital analyzer with a graphical interface, designed for analyzing and decoding unknown radio signals

items.name: System Informer
items.desc: powerful task manager for Windows. Shows processes, network connections, CPU/memory load in much more detail than the standard task manager. Useful for finding suspicious processes
